'''January 2001 Austin tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Austin, TX on 27 January 2001. It is known from Stephen Beckham's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1688">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-austin-texas-1-27-01d1688/ austin-texas-1-27-01], DeckTech (Stephen "Texan" Beckham, 29 January 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-01-29-austin-texas-1-27-01d1688/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 27 January 2001
* '''Site:''' Austin, TX
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
